title: Israeli Attacks Across Gaza Kill 3, Wound 15
detail: A wave of Israeli strikes and gunfire across the Gaza Strip on July 12–13, 2026 killed at least three Palestinians and wounded 15, according to Gaza's Ministry of Health. A drone strike on a motorcycle in the Tal al-Hawa neighborhood of southern Gaza City killed Osama Naim Shamlakh, 28, and wounded nine civilians nearby. Thaer Ramzi Fayyad, 36, later died of injuries sustained when Israeli fire struck a police post near the at-Twam roundabout in northwest Gaza City, wounding four officers. Other strikes hit a displaced-persons' tent in Al-Mawasi (Khan Younis), a vehicle on Al-Rashid Street in az-Zawayda, and an apartment in Maghazi refugee camp; gunfire was also reported east of Bureij camp and the Halawa displacement camp in eastern Jabalia with no casualties. Gaza's Health Ministry said 1,108 Palestinians have been killed and 3,578 wounded in strikes since the October 2025 ceasefire took effect.
